Waking up to the sound of a twig breaking, you sit bolt upright in your bedroll. You listen intently, but hear nothing for a good thirty seconds, until a metallic clacking noise, right behind your head. Turning to look at the source of the noise, you end up staring down the barrel of a beat up old .45 magnum. Holding the large revolver, is a woman, dirty, covered in tattoos, with a manic grin on her face. You can see her finger start to pull the trigger, until she narrows her eyes, and takes a better look at you.

Her eyes light up slightly, and her grin grows more devilish.

"Well, well, well...."

Her voice is husky, and a little hoarse, but strangely sultry.

"Lookie what I've found... A cute traveller, all alone..."

Her voice takes on a somewhat teasing quality, as she speaks.

"I guess what's going to happen, is you're gonna be my slave now. You're gonna do what I say, when I say, and I will allow you to keep your brain goop inside your skull. Deal?"

Stunned, you don't answer straight away, and she snaps, her grin gone, replaced with a manic anger.

"I ASKED YOU A FUCKING QUESTION, MEAT! ANSWER YES, OR I'LL SPRAY YOUR FUCKING FACE ALL OVER THE DIRT!"
